assets.exclude_note: What each package's own build makes: Windows x86-64 its runtime and the timezone library's code for it; Linux x86-64 the same and the zoneinfo data (tz.gyp target tzdata, which the Windows builds do not make); Linux arm64 and macOS the zoneinfo data (their own runtimes are not in this asset).
assets.description: Standalone runtimes for the platforms other than the package's own, built from this repository (commit 7f5d3e6c5aeb): Windows x86-32 and x86-64 and Linux x86-32 and x86-64 engines with their externals, the timezone library's code for them and its zoneinfo data; the Android runtime's Java layer (Runtime/Android/Classes), built from the same source; and the rest of the Android runtime with the timezone library's Android code, carried over unchanged from oxt-runtimes-1.15 (OpenXTalk Lite 1.15); and OXT-Beyond's own Android engine (Runtime/Android/Beyond), built from the same source, beside LiveCode Community 9.6.3's, which stays the default. See PROVENANCE.md in the archive.

assets.source: OXT-Beyond's CI builds win-x86, win-x86_64, linux-x86 and linux-x86_64 of commit 7f5d3e6c5aebf76596b8d1c4a6dbb7ff904cedff, made with tools/oxt/make_runtimes_asset.py --builds; the Android Java layer built from the same commit by tools/ci/android_java.py build; the other Android parts from oxt-runtimes-1.15; the Android engine Runtime/Android/Beyond from an Android engine run (android-engine.yml) of the same commit, its four build folders made one by tools/ci/android_engine.py merge
